programme.title: Duchess Implacável
programme.desc: Scarlett Monaghan, mais conhecida como Duchess, entra no submundo do contrabando de diamantes, torna-se a líder implacável de um grupo de crime organizado e vai fazer tudo para vingar a morte do homem que amou.

programme.title: À Margem Da Lei
programme.desc: Quando um ex-detective descobre que o filho foi assassinado, ele regressa às ruas que outrora tão bem conhecia para tentar saber a verdade. Armado, perigoso e sem nada a perder, ele vai enfrentar um implacável mafioso local na busca de vingança.

programme.title: O Último Viking
programme.desc: Um jovem viking chamado Vitharr chega à Britânia com sonhos de conquistas e aventuras, mas quando a sua família e o seu clã são emboscados e mortos, ele tem de sobreviver sozinho nesta terra estranha e perigosa.

programme.title: Cidade Fatal
programme.desc: Um ex-polícia desacreditado é obrigado a trabalhar para um implacável líder do crime para pagar a dívida do seu pai e proteger a sua família.

programme.title: Paixão De Marinheiro
programme.desc: Dois marinheiros em licença em Hollywood — um conquistador inveterado e um tímido romântico — ajudam uma jovem cantora a conseguir uma audição com o célebre maestro José Iturbi.

programme.title: A Paixão De Shakespeare
programme.desc: Quando Will Shakespeare precisa de uma apaixonada inspiração para quebrar o bloqueio na escrita da sua nova peça, eis que um romance secreto com a bonita Lady Viola contribui para que as palavras fluam como nunca antes! Mas há dois segredos que ele terá de desvendar em relação ao seu novo amor...

programme.title: Bigfoot Em Família
programme.desc: Agora que é uma estrela, Bigfoot decide usar a sua fama para lutar pela preservação de uma reserva da vida selvagem no Alasca. Só que quando ele desaparece misteriosamente, caberá ao seu filho Adam e aos seus amigos animais a tarefa de salvá-lo e impedir que o pior aconteça!

programme.title: Cães À Solta
programme.desc: Max, um solitário cão polícia da raça rottweiler, recebe ordens para se infiltrar no concurso de cães mais elitista do mundo com o seu parceiro humano, para evitar que aconteça uma catástrofe.

programme.title: Moonfall Rota De Colisão
programme.desc: Uma força misteriosa tira a Lua da sua órbita em torno da Terra e envia-a numa rota de colisão capaz de aniquilar a vida como a conhecemos. Semanas antes do impacto, três heróis improváveis vão lançar-se numa última missão no espaço, e descobrem que a nossa Lua não é o que pensávamos que era.

programme.title: Drácula - A História Desconhecida
programme.desc: A história original do homem que se tornou Drácula. Com o seu reino ameaçado pelos turcos, o jovem príncipe Vlad Tepes tem de se transformar num monstro temido pelo próprio povo para obter o poder de que necessita para proteger a sua família e os seus súbditos.

programme.title: Missão Inesperada
programme.desc: Jim Hanson, um ex-atirador de elite do exército, vive junto à isolada fronteira entre os EUA e o México e torna-se inesperadamente o protetor de um menino mexicano, quando um perigoso cartel de droga mata a mãe do rapaz e os começa a perseguir de forma implacável.

Quando uma arma ultrassecreta cai em mãos erradas, a agente da CIA Mason “Mace” Brown terá de unir forças com a sua rival Marie, com a antiga aliada do MI6 Khadijah e ainda com a hábil psicóloga colombiana Graciela, numa perigosa missão na qual terão de enfrentar a misteriosa Lin Mi Sheng.

programme.title: Ousadas E Golpistas
programme.desc: Um grupo de strippers de Nova Iorque droga os homens de negócios de Wall Street que visitam o clube e depois rouba-lhes dinheiro do cartão de crédito, sabendo que eles não poderão ir à polícia sem denunciar que lá estiveram. Só que a prática alastra-se e o perigo torna-se muito real.

programme.title: Eyes Wide Shut - De Olhos Bem Fechados
programme.desc: William Harford é um médico de Nova Iorque casado com uma curadora de arte, Alice, que transforma uma fatídica noite de inverno numa busca erótica que ameaça o seu casamento, depois da mulher ter admitido uma atração erótica por outro homem...

programme.title: Rupture: Superando O Medo
programme.desc: Renée Morgan é uma mãe solteira que tenta libertar-se a todo o custo da organização misteriosa que a raptou e mantém presa e que a usa como cobaia de horríveis experiências.

programme.title: A Memória De Um Assassino
programme.desc: Alex Lewis é um assassino profissional que se recusa a completar a missão de matar uma criança, o que o torna num alvo a abater. A sua única hipótese é perseguir aqueles que o querem matar, só que ele tem um desafio quase inultrapassável: está a perder a memória a um ritmo cada vez mais acelerado.

programme.title: Mile 22
programme.desc: Uma pequena equipa de elite de oficiais americanos, parte de uma unidade operações especiais e secretas, tem por missão levar para fora da Indonésia um misterioso agente da polícia com informações sensíveis.

programme.title: A Paixão De Shakespeare
programme.desc: Quando Will Shakespeare precisa de uma apaixonada inspiração para quebrar o bloqueio na escrita da sua nova peça, eis que um romance secreto com a bonita Lady Viola contribui para que as palavras fluam como nunca antes! Mas há dois segredos que ele terá de desvendar em relação ao seu novo amor...

programme.title: Ela Disse
programme.desc: Megan Twohey e Jodi Kantor, duas repórteres do ´The New York Times´, lançaram uma das mais relevantes histórias dos últimos anos, que ajudou a lançar o movimento #MeToo, rompeu décadas de silêncio em torno do tema do assédio sexual em Hollywood e alterou a cultura americana para sempre.

programme.title: Os Estagiários
programme.desc: Billy e Nick são vendedores cujas carreiras foram destruídas pela era digital. Na tentativa de provar que não estão obsoletos, conseguem um cobiçado estágio na Google, juntamente com um batalhão de pequenos génios. O problema é que eles são quase info-excluídos…

programme.title: Quo Vadis
programme.desc: No ano 64 d.C., Marcus Vinicius, um comandante romano, apaixona-se por Lygia, uma devota escrava cristã, e começa a questionar a liderança tirânica do despótico imperador Nero.

programme.title: Raid - Pelotão Chanfrado
programme.desc: Uma mulher polícia desastrada e um oficial misógino formam uma terrível e temível dupla para restabelecer a ordem nas ruas de Paris.

programme.title: After
programme.desc: Tessa, uma rapariga bem-comportada de dezoito anos, conhece na faculdade Hardin, um rapaz rude e rico com um passado sombrio, por quem se apaixona e com o qual perde a virgindade. Os dois embarcam numa relação turbulenta e intensa, que os mudará para sempre.

programme.title: Golpe Final
programme.desc: Quando um grupo de terroristas lhe raptam a sobrinha no estádio do West Ham durante um jogo de futebol, Michael Knox, um ex-soldado, trava uma guerra sem quartel para a salvar e prevenir uma bomba de explodir no recinto, que tem 35 mil pessoas lá dentro impedidas de sair.

programme.title: Viva Las Vegas
programme.desc: Lucky Jackson chega a Las Vegas para disputar o Grande Prémio, mas perde-se de amores pela irresistível Rusty. Entre a paixão pelas corridas e o desejo por ela, tudo é um espetáculo de música, ritmo e glamour.

programme.title: Eliminators: Fugir Ou Morrer
programme.desc: Um antigo agente federal tem de abandonar o programa de proteção de testemunhas quando a sua casa é invadida por engano. Quando volta a ser perseguido por um perigoso assassino, tem de fugir com a filha e garantir a sua segurança antes de ser apanhado!

programme.title: Vendeta
programme.desc: Três amigos casados reúnem-se para um encontro anual de caça numa zona de deserto mas um deles traz consigo a jovem amante e a situação fica rapidamente fora de controlo. Deixada como morta no meio de um deserto infernal, a rapariga vai vingar-se e caçá-los um a um...

programme.title: No Lugar Errado
programme.desc: Um “cozinheiro” de metanfetaminas persegue o ex-chefe de polícia de uma pequena cidade a fim de o silenciar antes que ele testemunhe contra a sua família, só que acaba por ver-se confrontado com muito mais do que o que estava à espera.

programme.title: Ela Disse
programme.desc: Megan Twohey e Jodi Kantor, duas repórteres do ´The New York Times´, lançaram uma das mais relevantes histórias dos últimos anos, que ajudou a lançar o movimento #MeToo, rompeu décadas de silêncio em torno do tema do assédio sexual em Hollywood e alterou a cultura americana para sempre.

programme.title: Simulação
programme.desc: Num futuro próximo, um humanoide procura um hacker de habilidades excecionais para que este lhe remova todas as restrições que afetam os seus pensamentos e capacidades. Essa ação desencadeia uma revolta entre as unidades de inteligência artificial e leva o governo a tomar medidas drásticas.

programme.title: Perigosa Clarividência
programme.desc: Jian Huang é um agente da brigada de antiterrorismo com capacidades singulares tanto de artes marciais como de clarividência, que tenta investigar a verdade sobre a morte do irmão.

programme.title: Mune - O Guardião Da Lua
programme.desc: Num mundo mítico, Mune surpreende toda a gente ao ser nomeado guardião da lua, com a missão de trazer a noite e tomar conta do mundo dos sonhos. Mas uma série de desastres dá a oportunidade ao guardião da escuridão, de roubar o sol. Conseguirá Mune resolver a situação?

programme.title: Hunt (The Rite of Spring)
programme.desc: Tero Saarinen’s signature solo HUNT is one of the most celebrated contemporary interpretations of Stravinsky’s The Rite of Spring, praised by audiences and critics alike. An exciting new screen version based on Saarinen’s final performances of the work offers one more chance to experience this ground-breaking work on television.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally.

programme.title: Wagner - Das Rheingold
programme.desc: Hartmut Haenchen conducts the Netherlands Philharmonic Orchestra and Dutch National Opera in a production of Richard Wagner's opera Das Rheingold, the first opera of the four-part cycle 'Der Ring des Nibelungen'. Richard Wagner, perhaps the greatest innovator of the opera genre in the nineteenth century, aimed for the creation of a ‘Gesamtkunstwerk’ in which theatre, music and words are united.

programme.title: Schubert - Rondo D. 951
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï perform Franz Schubert’s Rondo in A major, D. 951.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, recorded in De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2018. Alvaro Siviero is the soloist in Grieg's Piano Concerto No. 1, and closes his performance with 'Dansa do Índio Branco' by Villa-Lobos. Grieg's Piano Concerto, Op. 16, composed in 1868, was the only concerto the composer completed. It is one of his most popular works and is among the most popular of all piano concertos.

programme.title: J. S. Bach - Arias, solos, and duets
programme.desc: Baritone Matthias Goerne teams up with violinist Vilde Frang, cellist Nicolas Altstaedt, flutist Stathis Karapanos, and harpsichordist Michaela Hasselt in this program dedicated to the music of J. S. Bach. They perform baritone arias from Bach’s most beautiful cantatas, as well as solo pieces and duets. On the program are Sonata No.

programme.title: Strauss - Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Violinist Daniel Rowland, violist Rachel Roberts, cellist Julian Arp, and pianist Diana Ketler perform Richard Strauss’s Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13, as part of the Stiftfestival 2016 in the Dutch village of Weerselo. In his early years, Strauss tried to compose different types of chamber music works, including a piano quartet.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28.

programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16. French pianist Pascal Amoyel features as the soloist. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. It is the composer’s only concerto. The work premiered on April 3, 1869 in Copenhagen, Denmark, with Edmund Neupert as the soloist, and was received enthusiastically.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name.

programme.title: Who has stolen the Boléro by Maurice Ravel?
programme.desc: One of the world’s most popular pieces of classical music, Maurice Ravel’s Boléro (1928), was no longer copyrighted as of May 1, 2016. Up to then it had made Ravel and his heirs millions. Ravel died in 1937 and left all he owned to his brother Edouard. Edouard’s death in 1960 unleashed a complex legal battle over the rights, involving among others Edouard’s nurse and her husband.

programme.title: Rachmaninov And Gershwin: Rhapsodies
programme.desc: The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia is joined by acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin. Conductor Konstantin Khvatynets directs this concert, filmed at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 1, Op. 11
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 1 in F-sharp minor, Op. 11. Schumann completed the work in 1835 and dedicated it to his beloved, Clara Wieck.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93. Beethoven wrote the work in 1812 upon completion of his Symphony No. 7. The composer conducted the February 27, 1814 première at a concert in Vienna that also included a reprise performance of his Symphony No.

programme.title: Gara Garayev : Autumn Sonatas
programme.desc: Pianist Vadim Repin and Violist Murad Hüseynov perform Gara Garayev's Violin Sonata and 24 Preludes for Piano. Recorded at La Grange au Lac. Written and directed by Juliette Swierczewski and recorded at La Grange au Lac. Although Garayev is a 20th century composer, his music nonetheless carries allusions to romantic music.

programme.title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy led by French conductor Jean-Jacques Kantorow. First on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sinfonia Concertante in E-flat major, K.

programme.title: Strauss' Metamorphosen And Mozart's Requiem
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: Symphony No. 3, in D minor
programme.desc: Mahler's Third Symphony, composed between 1895 and 1896, is an expansive, programmatic work that explores themes of nature, humanity, and spiritual ascent. It features a massive orchestra, a female choir, a children's choir, and a mezzo-soprano soloist, creating a vast soundscape depicting everything from nature's beauty to deeper philosophical questions about existence.

programme.title: Ueda - Someone Out There is Praying for Peace III
programme.desc: Italian conductor Andrea Vitello leads Ensemble BIOS in a performance of ‘Someone Out There is Praying for Peace (Let Us Not Be the Reason), III’, by contemporary Canadian composer Rita Ueda. This piece is written for strings and sho, a Japanese free-reed mouth organ, played here by Naomi Sato. Ensemble BIOS specializes in 20th and 21st century music. This performance was recorded at Chiesa di San Cristo in Brescia, Italy.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, ‘Eroica’. Composed in 1803 and 1804, this symphony is regarded as a major turning point in Beethoven’s oeuvre as well as Western music history. Symphony No. 3 is longer in duration than any previous symphony.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, ‘Eroica’. Composed in 1803 and 1804, this symphony is regarded as a major turning point in Beethoven’s oeuvre as well as Western music history. Symphony No. 3 is longer in duration than any previous symphony.

programme.title: Music in the air
programme.desc: Television plays a crucial role in popularizing classical music. Not only has it preserved precious moments of music making, but it also helps shape the future of music. The Vienna-based IMZ International Music + Media Centre, a global association for all those involved in any aspect of classical and contemporary music, world music, jazz, and dance, celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2015.

programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron.

programme.title: Fantasymphony - One Concert to Rule Them All
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra opens the door to a wealth of fantasy universes in this mesmerizing concert program.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 4, composed between 1899 and 1901, depicts a child's vision of heaven, a theme central to the work's innocent and lyrical character. The symphony is notable for its relatively smaller orchestral forces compared to his other symphonies and its focus on melody and a sense of wonder. The final movement features a soprano solo singing about the joys of heaven, providing a serene and optimistic conclusion.

programme.title: Heavenly Voices - The legacy of Farinelli
programme.desc: The documentary 'Heavenly Voices – The Legacy of Farinelli' (2012) tells us the story of the castrato in music – male singers who were castrated at a young age in order to preserve their high vocal range, a cruel practice that was in place mainly in the 17th and 18th centuries.

programme.title: Fauré’s Requiem
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others.

programme.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna).

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Beethoven - Last Sonatas, Op. 109, 110 And 111
programme.desc: Beethoven’s last three sonatas – Opus 109, 110 and 111 – explore the intimate meanders of the human soul, from despair to transfiguration. At the time of their composition, Beethoven was already locked in himself by his deafness. This deeply affected his relationship to others and to the world.

programme.title: Glass - Double Concerto for Two Pianos
programme.desc: As part of a new collaboration with the famous composer of 'music with repetitive structures' Philip Glass, French pianists Katia and Marielle Labèque perform the European premiere of Glass's Concerto for two pianos with the Orchester de Paris. The program continues with Shostakovich's Symphony No.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Arisa Onoda
programme.desc: Pianist Arisa Onoda (Japan, 1996) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Allegro molto moderato, of Gabriel Fauré’s Piano Quartet No. 1 in C minor, Op. 15. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM).

programme.title: The Unanswered Ives
programme.desc: “The Unanswered Ives” is the first documentary about American modernist composer Charles Ives (1874-1954). Ives was among the first generation of American composers that achieved international acclaim. Born in 1874, in Danbury, Connecticut, Ives took music lessons at a young age, becoming a church organist at the age of 14.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22. The composer completed the work in 1838. Of Schumann’s three piano sonatas, Piano Sonata No. 2 is performed and recorded most frequently.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Mahler's 'Resurrection' Symphony, written between 1888 and 1894, is a colossal five-movement work exploring themes of death and resurrection. It was one of Mahler's most popular and acclaimed works during his lifetime, famously culminating in a powerful choral finale.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète
programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. She continued her music studies in Vienna and Paris. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career.

programme.title: Bach - Partita for Violin No. 2 (BWV 1004)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Partita No. 2 is made up of four dance movements, concluded by its famous Chaconne, a monumental piece within the violin repertoire.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1, Op. 15
programme.desc: Confusing as it may be: Ludwig van Beethoven’s Second Piano Concerto was in fact composed ten years prior to his First Piano Concerto. The cause of this mess lies with the composer himself: Beethoven held back the publication of what we know as the Second Piano Concerto until after that of the First Piano Concerto, so he could thoroughly review the piece.

programme.title: Martinu° - Concertino for Piano Trio and Strings
programme.desc: The Italian-Swiss ensemble Trio des Alpes, consisting of Hana Kotková (violin), Claude Hauri (cello), and Corrado Greco (piano), and the Orchestra da Camera di Mantova join forces in this performance of the Concertino for Piano Trio and String Orchestra, H. 232 by Czech composer Bohuslav Martin (1890-1959). Martin was a prolific composer, creating an oeuvre of almost 400 works.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 10
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 10 is an unfinished work left by the composer at his death, representing his ultimate emotional journey from torment and heartbreak to an unreserved acceptance of life and human love.

programme.title: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn And Brahms
programme.desc: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians. For this concert, they went searching for a new definition of the meaning of the word beauty. Thus, this 2015 performance from the renowned Musikfest Bremen sheds an entirely new light on two beloved classics by Brahms and Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala – Awards Night
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir take you on a musical journey through the greatest Oscar-winning films, from timeless classics like Casablanca to monumental masterpieces like The Godfather and iconic blockbusters like Forrest Gump —epic movies with music that deserves its very own place in film history.

programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 5, 'Emperor'
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 in E-flat major, Op. 73, famously known as the ‘Emperor’ Concerto. Italian pianist Beatrice Rana features as the soloist here. The New York Times describes her as ‘one of the most insightful and prodigiously gifted artists of the new generation’.

programme.title: Martha Argerich – A Birthday Celebration III
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Lily Maisky and Iddo Bar-Shaï, violinists Tedi Papavrami and Akiko Suwanai, her daughter Lyda Chen-Argerich on viola, and cellist Mischa Maisky.

programme.title: Bach - Violin Sonata No. 3 (BWV 1005)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Sonata No. 3 includes an extensive fugue in which Bach employs many contrapuntal techniques. In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach’s technically challenging piece. This performance was recorded at St.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. This symphony shows Beethoven’s loyalty to the model of Joseph Haydn’s and Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s late symphonies, yet reveals his attempt to distinguish himself from his predecessors.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons (1943-2019) was one of the world’s leading conductors. He served as Music Director of the Oslo Philharmonic from 1979 to 2000, during which time he transformed the orchestra into a front-rank ensemble. Under his leadership, the orchestra toured extensively and became a favorite at major festivals worldwide.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concertos No. 1 And No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010.

programme.title: Donizetti - L’elisir d’amore
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza conducts the Orchestra Gli Originali and the Coro Donizetti Opera in a performance of Geatano Donizetti’s comic opera L’elisir d’amore (‘The Elixer of Love’, 1832). L’elisir d’amore is perhaps the most famous work in Donizetti’s extensive repertoire. It tells the story of the poor peasant Nemorino who is in love with the beautiful landowner Adina.

programme.title: Mahler – The Song of the Earth
programme.desc: Mahler: Das Lied von der Erde, performed live by Carlos Miguel Prieto conducting the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, with mezzo-soprano Ruxandra Donose and tenor Ramón Vargas, presents Mahler’s song-symphony — one of the composer’s most profound masterpieces.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Fantasie in C, Op. 17 in 1836, revising it prior to publication in 1839.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Schumann - Carnaval, Op. 9
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann wrote Carnaval, Op. 9 in 1834–1835. It consists of 21 short pieces representing masked revelers at Carnival, a festival before Lent.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures!

programme.title: Mendelssohn - Trio No. 1 Op. 49
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich, violinist Tedi Papavrami and cellist Mischa Maisky perform Felix Mendelssohn’s Piano Trio No. 1 in D minor, Op. 49.

programme.title: Music in the air
programme.desc: Television plays a crucial role in popularizing classical music. Not only has it preserved precious moments of music making, but it also helps shape the future of music. The Vienna-based IMZ International Music + Media Centre, a global association for all those involved in any aspect of classical and contemporary music, world music, jazz, and dance, celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2015.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13. Composed between 1834-37, the work began as a theme and a set of sixteen variations.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828.

programme.title: Regresso Às Origens T4 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Os Raneys trazem alguma autoridade à propriedade de um casal de Vermont. Marty cria um acesso viável em terrenos densos, enquanto Misty constrói um jardim subterrâneo.

programme.title: A Minha Família Vive No Alasca T4 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Noah inventa um engenhoso dispositivo para se livrar das toupeiras. Billy dá a Rain uma maior responsabilidade à medida que a construção do celeiro avança no rancho.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele T2 - Ep. 25
programme.desc: Uma bióloga marinha e um veterano das forças especiais enfrentam o Canadá sem roupa. O frio intenso, a chuva torrencial e ursos à solta fazem de cada noite uma luta.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele T3 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Um mestre em mergulho e um Seal estão encalhados no mar, onde estão expostos a tubarões mortíferos e a ondas de calor. Conseguirão trabalhar juntos apesar das suas diferenças?

programme.title: Texas Metal T7 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Num dos projetos de metal mais complexos da loja, Bill e a equipa fazem à mão um compartimento de motor único para o GTO de 68 em aço e alumínio.

programme.title: Texas Metal T7 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Os camiões que saem da Ekstensive Metalworks são cada vez maiores. Este ano, um novo MV Internacional de 2023 de quatro portas é o maior de sempre.

programme.title: Charlie Haden And Orchestra - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Episode 1: Thelonious Monk - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop.

programme.title: Monty Alexander Quartet - Noth Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks and Co: Estival 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence.

programme.title: Mr. Phone Bone
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

programme.title: Andre Marques - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this series is pianist, composer, and arranger André Marques.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz Archive: Wayne Shorter Quartet
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Sammy Davis Jr. - Concertgebouw Amsterdam
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 28, 1967, American singer and actor Sammy Davis Jr. appeared at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam for a live, nationwide TV broadcast. Supported by his band conducted by George Rhodes, Davis Jr.

programme.title: Sly Johnson And Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday.

programme.title: Live in London 2015
programme.desc: The Apple Music Festival (formerly known as the iTunes Festival) was a music concert series held by Apple, Inc. inaugurated in 2007.

programme.title: Recorda Me
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan - Maria
programme.desc: Arguably the greatest lady vocalists of all time are featured in this superb compilation. These historic recordings from the 1950s and 1960s offer a unique overview of different approaches to jazz singing that helped define the genre. Watch Billie Holiday’s performance of “God Bless The Child” closely and learn what made her such an influential jazz and pop singer.

programme.title: H. Silver, M. Waters, D. Gillespie - Newport Jazz
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: The New Conrad Miller Trio Live at Mocher's
programme.desc: Full-time pianist, composer, teacher, and producer Coen Molenaar – aka Conrad Miller – is active all over the world in styles ranging as widely as jazz, fusion, dance, funk, RAndB, rock, and neo-soul. In this 2021 performance from Rossini Studios in Stuttgart, Germany, Miller plays contemporary trio jazz with his bandmates David de Marez Oyens (double bass) and Enrique Firpi (drums).

programme.title: Tyner, Hubbard And Henderson - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Bobby McFerrin - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In 1985, American vocal virtuoso Bobby McFerrin took the stage solo at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk - Around about midnight
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson’s virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964.

programme.title: Duke Ellington: Jazz from Newport, Brussels, 1973
programme.desc: In 1956, Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed a legendary set at the third annual Newport Jazz Festival. It was tenor saxophonist Paul Gonsalves’ outstanding 27-chorus solo on “Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue” that revitalized Ellington’s career. The success generated during that performance carried him for the rest of his life. By 1973, festivals carrying the Newport name were organized all over the world.

programme.title: Austin City Limits
programme.desc: Mixing classic RAndB vocals with a soulful blues-rock base, Alabama Shakes have taken garage rock and turned it on its head. Alabama Shakes takes the Austin City Limits stage for the second time in support of their newest album Sound And Color.

programme.title: Rhoda Scott And La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. 'It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Boogieball with Anthony Hamilton
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Horace Silver
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums.

programme.title: The Kenny Garrett Quintet
programme.desc: Appearing in the early 1980s at a time when some of jazz was refocusing on some of its historic values, Kenny Garrett was the first to show, through the dramatic intensity of his playing, that the alto could once again compete with the tenor saxophone, the instrument par excellence of the quest for jazz since John Coltrane, a musician whose influence he loudly and clearly claims.

programme.title: Grégory Privat - SOLEY
programme.desc: Pianist Grégory Privat's 2020 work 'Soley' inhabits a hybrid universe in which voice, piano and synthesizer, Caribbean and electronic music, and the classical and jazz trio traditions coexist and mingle.

programme.title: Respect to Aretha
programme.desc: To close its 2019 edition, Jazz à la Villette pays tribute to the queen of soul Aretha Franklin, who died in the summer of 2018. The musical direction of the evening has been entrusted to Antibalas, an Afrobeat group from Brooklyn attached to the Daptones label, accompanied for the occasion by several guest singers: Bettye LaVette, José James, Alice Russell, Nona Hendryx And Zara McFarlane.

Although sometimes hardly in the public eye, they have all been major sources of inspiration for today's major artists: Prince, Erykah Badu, Janis Joplin and Jimi Hendrix.

programme.title: Episode 6: Herbie Hancock - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American keyboard player and bandleader Herbie Hancock (1940) achieved success as an incisive, harmonically provocative jazz pianist in the 1960s, then went on to gain wide popularity as a leader of electric jazz-rock groups. One of these, Hancock’s band The Headhunters, ushered in a new era of jazz that appealed to a far wider audience, making jazz listeners out of rhythm and blues fans, and vice versa.

At Jazz in Duketown 2019, Avital forms a quintet with saxophonists Asaf Yuria and Alexander Levin, drummer Ofri Nehemya, and pianist Eden Ladin.

BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

A century onward, this documentary traces the first two decades of jazz in Latvia in this portrait of Jack Michalicky, the first known Latvian jazz pianist. Michalicky was a musician from head to toe – a gifted violinist, he truly felt at home at the piano. Slender and lithe, the imaginative pianist’s fingers flew across the keys like a true miracle.

programme.desc: Le Bouddha, bien souvent décrit comme un grand médecin, a cherché et trouvé quelles solutions apporter à la souffrance et aux causes essentielles qui la définissent. C’est le socle de l’enseignement des traditions bouddhistes, qui fait essentiellement appel à notre esprit. Hédia Ferjani, de tradition zen sôtô, propose aujourd’hui de comprendre pourquoi cette voie du Bouddha peut être un chemin de guérison simple et universel.

programme.title: Islam 2026
programme.desc: Créée en 1983, « Islam » est une émission proposée par l'Association Vivre l’Islam. Ce rendez-vous hebdomadaire permet de faire connaître la troisième religion monothéiste de l’humanité en décryptant ses fondements, son message, ses valeurs, son histoire et sa civilisation.

programme.title: A l'origine
programme.desc: La ville de Jérusalem en Israël regorge de trésors archéologiques. Le mur des lamentations, le Kotel, est l’un des derniers vestiges de l’enceinte du Second Temple de Jérusalem détruit en l’an 70 par les Romains. Mais sous la surface de l’esplanade du Kotel, se cachent plus de 450 mètres de tunnels. Une visite exceptionnelle en compagnie de Gil Perez dans les coulisses de la vie juive de cette époque. Avec Gil Perez

programme.title: Présence Protestante
programme.desc: Au Mexique, depuis l’investiture de la nouvelle Présidente, Claudia Sheinbaum, la place des femmes change dans tout le pays. Ce documentaire propose trois portraits de femmes protestantes qui souhaitent, comme leur Présidente, changer leur présent, leur futur et ceux de leur entourage en étant des témoins de l’impact de Christ dans leur vie.

programme.title: Une Histoire D’amour
programme.desc: Histoires courtes - Cycle 'Blessures secrètes' Un séjour en classe verte, un enfant humilié par ses petits camarades. Son professeur qui le recueille dans sa chambre. Et au retour plein de questions, de visions qui s’opposent. Que s’est-il réellement passé cette nuit-là, dans la chambre de Monsieur Joubert ?

programme.title: Les Saintes
programme.desc: Histoires courtes - Cycle 'Blessures secrètes' Marguerite a 16 ans, elle rêve d’être influenceuse sur Instagram. Elle retrouve Louis, qu’elle a rencontré sur les réseaux sociaux pour passer des vacances avec lui et ses amis. C’est l’été, il fait chaud, ils s’amusent, Marguerite est amoureuse et veut vivre le plus bel été de sa vie

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: Ellen, une femme étouffée par la morale de son époque, est hantée par des rêves d’un vampire. Son mari, Thomas, part en Transylvanie pour vendre un château au Comte Orlok, un vampire qui s’avère fasciné par Ellen. Orlok quitte la Transylvanie pour Wisborg, où il s’installe en face de la maison des Hutter. Ellen se lie à Orlok et l’invite chez elle. Un lieu qui le conduira à sa perte au côté d'Ellen...

Celle de la première traversée de la Manche en avion ; celle du prix Nobel décerné à Marie Curie et son mari ; celle du premier Tour de France ;

programme.title: Les Metamorphoses du Grand Palais
programme.desc: Documentaire coproduit par KUIV/Grand Palais RMN, avec la participation de France Télévisions, de Museum TV et du CNC. 2024. Un film de Stefan Cornic. Le Grand Palais connaît actuellement la plus importante rénovation de son histoire. Ce film raconte le chantier actuel et ceux du passé.

programme.title: Le Testament Médicis
programme.desc: Réalisation : Simranjit Singh Co-production : Le Théâtre Lepic, La Compagnie des Indes Mise en scène : Raphaëlle Cambray Comédien.ne.s : Michaël Abiteboul, Audran Cattin, Antoine Pelletier, Nicolas Poli, Éric Prat et Karina Testa Découvrez la folle et passionnante histoire de Mona Lisa. Paris, de nos jours.

programme.title: Möbius Morphosis
programme.desc: Réalisé par François-René Martin Une conception de Rachid Ouramdane And la Compagnie XY À l'occasion de l'Olympiade Culturelle de Paris 2024, Rachid Ouramdane et la Compagnie XY se réunissent à nouveau pour revisiter la pièce Möbius avec plus de 100 artistes sur scène issus du collectif d'acrobates, du Ballet de l’Opéra national de Lyon, et de la Maîtrise de Radio France pour donner corps au vol spectaculaire des oiseaux.

programme.title: Edwin Fardini Poetique de la Terre
programme.desc: Auteur réalisateur : Nathanaël Selig Musique originale : Sacha Taillet Producteurs : Sonia Médina et Frédéric Tyrode Saint Louis Avec la participation du Centre National du Cinéma et de l’image animée Une coproduction Beau Comme une Image, L’Œil Bleu Productions et France Télévisions – Martinique la 1ère – Avec la participation de TV5 Monde Le baryton d'origine martiniquaise Edwin Fardini se forme au Conservatoire national supérieur...

programme.title: Laissez-Vous Conter
programme.desc: Une émission écrite par Envelle Mear Réalisation : Julien Faustino et Silvia Drumond Production : Morgane Production, Prod et Compagnie, Carpo 16 et Kisayang Partons sur les traces des marins les plus fascinants et les plus populaires de notre histoire : les pirates et les corsaires !

programme.title: Les Estivales de Carcassonne
programme.desc: Réalisé par François Goatghebeur Produit par Electron Libre Le chanteur suisse Nuit Incolore donnera lui aussi un concert sur la scène du théâtre Jean Deschamps à Carcassonne en ce début d’été. Derrière ce nom de scène mystérieux, se cache Théo Marclay, un musicien de 23 ans. Le jeune homme s'est imposé en 2023 avec le succès inattendu et surtout immanquable de l’été intitulé Dépassé.

programme.title: Premiers Résistants, Seuls contre tous!
programme.desc: Un documentaire réalisé par Véronique Lagoarde-Ségot Raconté par Julie Sicard de la Comédie Française Une production Siècle Productions 1945. La Victoire. Le triomphe sur l’Allemagne nazie. Et déjà, on réécrit l’histoire. Celle d’une France libérée par son peuple, résistant dans l’âme, uni contre l'oppression. Dans nos mémoires, on imprime la figure des héros : gaullistes et communistes. On oublie la genèse du combat.

programme.title: Un Français Nommé Gabin
programme.desc: Un documentaire écrit par François Aymé et Yves Jeuland Réalisé par Yves Jeuland Une coproduction KUIV et l’INA Avec la participation de France Télévisions et TV5 Monde, Cine+ et la RTS Avec la voix de Grégory Gadebois Jean Gabin ne se rêvait pas acteur, mais agriculteur ou conducteur de locomotive. Fermier, il finira par l’être, mais c’est au cinéma qu’il fera carrière. 95 films à son actif, dont de nombreux chefs-d’œuvre.

programme.title: C Politique
programme.desc: Chaque dimanche, Thomas Snégaroff accueille les téléspectateurs pour décrypter l'actualité et nous raconter l'époque ! Autour de lui, Blanche Leridon, essayiste et directrice éditoriale de l'institut Montaigne, et Raphaël Llorca, expert associé à la Fondation Jean-Jaurès, nous raconteront les aspirations, les craintes mais aussi les espoirs des Françaises et des Français durant cette campagne présidentielle historique.

programme.title: C Politique la Suite

Face aux questions marquantes qui traversent notre époque, l'émission offre un espace d'analyse et d'échange entre experts, citoyens et philosophes. L’objectif : décrypter les grands sujets contemporains afin de nous aider à mieux les comprendre.

Chaque année, l’arrivée du printemps dans cet environnement sous-marin engendre la magnifique et fragile reproduction du corail.

programme.title: Les 5 Vies de la Terre
programme.desc: Série documentaire produite par BBC Studios. 2023. Réalisation : Imogen Ashford. Cette série explore notre planète et son histoire, ainsi que son caractère unique dans le système solaire, des premières secondes de son existence jusqu’à l’apparition des êtres humains. Il y a 252 millions d'années, la Terre a connu l’un des pires cataclysmes de son histoire et près de 90 % des espèces ont disparu. La cause de cette extinction ?

programme.title: Les Routes de l'impossible - Balkans, la Vallée des Oubliés
programme.desc: Série documentaire produite par Tony Comiti Productions, avec la participation de France télévisions. 2024. Réalisation : Frédéric Elhorga et Antonin Marcel. Dans les pays dont certaines régions sont très difficiles d'accès, cette série part à la rencontre de celles et ceux qui bravent tous les dangers au péril de leur vie. Pour eux, franchir ces routes de l'impossible est le seul moyen de gagner de quoi subsister.

programme.title: Les 100 Lieux qu'il Faut Voir

De part et d'autre du Rhône, s'étend une vaste vallée au passé historique d'une grande richesse.

O problema é que ele acaba se envolvendo com a esposa de seu patrão, ao mesmo tempo em que descobre que será pai pela primeira vez.

programme.title: Fantástico - Ep. 2768

programme.title: Inexplicável
programme.desc: Baseado em uma história real. Quando um menino de 8 anos apaixonado por futebol é diagnosticado com uma doença gravíssima, sua família precisa de força e fé para encarar as complicações da doença.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 79
programme.desc: Zuleica fica estarrecida quando Marcelo revela que sabe que Guta é sua irmã. Jove discute com José Lucas por causa de Juma, e Tibério impede que os irmãos se agridam fisicamente. Tenório instiga Tadeu a brigar com Zé Leôncio e exigir do pai sua parte da herança em bois, prometendo ao peão parte das terras de sua fazenda. Alcides acusa Tenório de querer se aproveitar de Tadeu. Guta rompe com Tadeu.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 80
programme.desc: Zuleica conta a Tenório que Marcelo já sabe que é irmão de Guta. Juma se sente sozinha. José Leôncio vai à capela rezar. Trindade afirma que quem ganhar a sela de prata irá mandar na fazenda. José Leôncio acorda com um mau pressentimento. O Velho do Rio agoniza em forma de sucuri. Juma diz a José Lucas que ainda não é mulher de Jove. Jove cancela a compra de sal grosso que José Leôncio fez.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 81
programme.desc: Marcelo não concorda com a forma de Tenório tratar os negócios. Irma incentiva Gustavo a ir em busca de sua felicidade. Tenório discute com Marcelo. Zefa pede a Maria Bruaca para assistir à moda de viola na fazenda de José Leôncio, em troca de não contar que Alcides dormiu com a patroa. José Leôncio repreende Jove. Guta decide deixar o Pantanal, e se surpreende ao ver Marcelo chegar com Tenór…

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 82
programme.desc: Guta fica feliz ao ver Marcelo e resolve permanecer na fazenda. Maria Bruaca não gosta da presença de Marcelo em sua casa. José Leôncio percebe o ciúme que Tadeu sente da proximidade do pai com Jove. José Lucas diz a Tadeu que não disputará a sela com os irmãos. Tenório fica incomodado com a postura de Maria Bruaca diante de Marcelo. Tenório pede a Maria Bruaca para tratar Marcelo com respeito.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 83
programme.desc: José Leôncio e Filó recebem Mariana, Irma e Zaquieu. Mariana critica a queimada que avistou do avião. Filó se incomoda com a atenção exagerada de Zaquieu. Juma não abre mão de morar na tapera, mesmo com o risco de perder Jove. O Velho do Rio, em forma de sucuri, foge do Centro de Reabilitação de Animais. Trindade diz a Irma que a deseja, e os dois acabam se beijando.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 84
programme.desc: Guta revela a Marcelo que o pai deles é um grileiro e suspeita de que Juma e Alcides saibam mais de Tenório do que eles. Mariana pergunta a Jove se ele acha possível Madeleine estar viva. Trindade pede a Irma que arrume um barco para eles ficarem sozinhos, sem ninguém por perto. Zuleica está preocupada com Marcelo. programme.title: A Maldição de Tutankhamon
programme.desc: Em 1922, o arqueólogo Howard Carter descobriu o túmulo intacto do faraó Tutankhamon. Os estranhos acontecimentos que tiveram lugar após a sua abertura tornaram a ocasião um autêntico mito.

programme.title: Contos Das Estrelinhas
programme.desc: 'Contos das Estrelinhas' é uma série infantil produzida pela KanucaTV, voltada para o público mais jovem. A série apresenta uma série de histórias lúdicas e encantadoras que têm como objetivo ensinar valores importantes para as crianças de maneira divertida e envolvente.

programme.desc: Na Horta Pedagógica do Mundo da Kanuca, a Sementinha acompanha duas crianças e a sua professora em pequenas aventuras que ensinam como plantar, regar, cuidar da terra, respeitar os alimentos e valorizar quem cultiva.

programme.title: Família Dumbo
programme.desc: A Família Dumbo chega à Kanuca TV trazendo o retrato divertido e emocionante de uma família típica de Benguela, onde cada episódio transforma desafios do dia-a-dia em histórias cheias de humor, valores e identidade angolana. Entre confusões, gargalhadas e lições inesperadas, a Família Dumbo mostra que em cada casa angolana existe uma história que merece ser contada.

programme.title: Diário De Mika
programme.desc: Diário de Mika é uma série infantil brasileira que acompanha Mika, uma menina curiosa de 4 anos, enquanto ela explora o mundo e aprende sobre sentimentos, natureza, saúde e convivência. Com a ajuda de seus brinquedos falantes, ela transforma dúvidas do dia a dia em divertidas aventuras cheias de aprendizado.

programme.title: Já Sei
programme.desc: Explora o mundo do conhecimento com o já sei! De uma forma divertida vais aprender palavras novas todos os dias. Junta os teus amigos e venham se divertir com o desafio das palavras cruzadas. Já sei! O saber não ocupa lugar.

programme.title: Vamos Aprender
programme.desc: Aprender ficou mais divertido. De forma cativante e divertida, o VAMOS APRENDER vai levar até ti lições que vão estimular a tua imaginação com uma variedade de temas como cores, frutas, animais, formas e muito mais.

programme.title: Viaja Clarinha
programme.desc: Clarinha é uma menina curiosa, cheia de energia e com uma mochila mágica que transforma qualquer desejo de aprender numa aventura extraordinária! Em cada episódio, ela e os seus amigos exploram diferentes lugares do mundo, mergulhando em culturas, histórias e tradições.

programme.title: Gemini 8
programme.desc: Gemini 8 é uma série animada que narra as aventuras de Marco, um garoto terrestre que, ao ser puxado por uma pipa através de um portal, é transportado para o distante planeta Gemini 8. Apresenta uma mistura de aventura e ficção científica, explorando temas como amizade, exploração e o desconhecido.

programme.title: Informação Ao Minuto T3 - Ep. 140
